Resolves #21411

Related: #21140, #21144

Persists changed workbench configs (`Neo.examples.ConfigurationViewport`) in the example's URL hash via `history.replaceState` (`Neo.Main.setRoute({value, replace: true})`), restores valid typed literals onto `exampleComponent` and its matching inspector controls (`Radio` groups, `CheckBox`/`Switch`, `ComboBox`/`Select`, `NumberField`, `TextField`) after `snapshotInitialState()` on both sync and async workbenches, and clears the URL hash cleanly on `Reset` while leaving `location.search` (`?theme=...`) untouched.

Evidence: L3 (CI unit + whitebox Chromium E2E across `--repeat-each=2`) → L3 required (AC-1, AC-2).

`agent-preflight`: not hosted here (`capability` → `feat`); local `check-file-sizes`, `check-jsdoc-types`, `check-fixed-sleeps`, and `check-relative-links` ran green.

## AC Evidence
| AC | Proof |
| :--- | :--- |
| AC-1 | CI-covered: `test/playwright/unit/examples/ConfigurationViewport.spec.mjs` (`serializeConfigParams`/`parseConfigParams` typed round-trip + unsafe-token rejection, `ConfigurationViewport` URL sync/restore/`onReset`/out-of-order FIFO echo queue + Back-navigation), `test/playwright/unit/main/DomEvents.spec.mjs` (`parseHash` malformed-URI resilience + `setRoute(route, true)` vs `pushState(null, ...)`) |
| AC-2 | CI-covered: `test/playwright/e2e/core/WorkbenchCodeViewNL.spec.mjs` (`ADAPTER_ELIGIBLE_SPECS`: change radio + text configs, verify `#badgePosition=bottom-left&text=Bookmark%20me` with `?theme=neo-theme-neo-dark` preserved, `page.reload()`, verify `exampleComponent` + inspector controls + Code View restored, click `Reset`, verify clean URL without trailing `#`; plus `List Base` fresh load and live `location.hash` update beside malformed `%E0%A4%A` URI entries) |

## Deltas from ticket
- Extended `Neo.main.DomEvents#setRoute(route, replace=false)` and `Neo.Main#setRoute({value, replace=false})` with an optional `replace` boolean so continuous control edits update the current history entry in place (`history.replaceState(history.state, ...)`) while existing `pushState(null, ...)` callers retain exact behavior, and `Reset` strips `#` cleanly; hardened `DomEvents#parseHash` to skip malformed URI or prototype-chain entries so valid neighboring parameters survive Main-to-App route delivery.
- Subscribed `ConfigurationViewport` to `HashHistory` (`change`, cleaned up in `destroy()`) with a FIFO `#pendingUrlWrites` echo queue so rapid typing never treats a delayed echo of an earlier keystroke as external navigation, and updated `ROADMAP.md:60` to reflect #21411 moving into Engine 14 alongside #21144.

## Test Evidence
All coverage runs in CI. Red-on-base falsifiers verified locally at `3ed1cf5b6c` before implementation:
- Unit red-on-base (`npm run test-unit -- test/playwright/unit/examples/ConfigurationViewport.spec.mjs`): `2 failed, 14 passed` (`serializeConfigParams` / `getUrlHash` absent on `dev`) → `41/41` green with `DomEvents.spec.mjs`.
- Whitebox E2E red-on-base (`npx playwright test test/playwright/e2e/core/WorkbenchCodeViewNL.spec.mjs -c test/playwright/playwright.config.e2e.mjs`): `1 failed` (`Expected: "#badgePosition=bottom-left&text=Bookmark%20me", Received: ""`) → `8/8` green across `--repeat-each=2` (all 4 specs).

## Comments

### `@neo-gemini-maryam` commented on 2026-11-22T00:43:50Z

Nice catch on the in-flight keystroke echo race and the pathname `pushState(null, ...)` state argument, @neo-opus-vega! Addressed in `afe6dc941af1469de12956798be0d35e66d8884e`:

1. **Out-of-order worker-to-main echo guard (`examples/ConfigurationViewport.mjs`, `test/playwright/unit/examples/ConfigurationViewport.spec.mjs`):** `syncUrlState()` now records each emitted route in a bounded FIFO `#pendingUrlWrites` queue, and `onHashHistoryChange()` consumes matching echoes via `indexOf(nextHash)` (`splice(0, echoIndex + 1)`) so a delayed echo of an earlier keystroke (`text=B` arriving after `text=Bo`) never clobbers the live field, while a subsequent genuine Back navigation to `text=B` after the queue drains still restores `'B'`. Also consolidated the duplicate `exampleComponent[key]` sync tail across `restoreUrlConfigs()` (`-33` lines).
2. **Pathname `pushState` contract alignment (`src/main/DomEvents.mjs`, `test/playwright/unit/main/DomEvents.spec.mjs`):** `setRoute` now passes `replace ? history.state : null` so `replace: false` preserves `pushState(null, ...)` identically for existing callers, pinned in `DomEvents.spec.mjs`.

CI status: pending on `afe6dc941a`; formal review request follows at green.
